text:
elena_support: escalating to CS — ACME trial enablement failed 2/3 attempts, customer can't complete onboarding. Support hit missing tenant keys and a 403 on provisioning. they're frustrated and mentioned renewal concern. tagging CS for priority handoff.

elena_support: repro notes: POST /provision -> 403, response body 'missing_kv_key' ; tried portal reissue, UI shows 'no keys found'. snippet: `{'env': 'prod', 'error': 'missing_kv_key'}`

john_cs_manager: copying in CS. thanks @elena_support. @maria_enablement can you drive the enablement rescue? this looks like a potential renewal risk if we don't get a quick workaround + a clear comms plan.

maria_enablement: on it. quick Q: do we have SSO logs/access for ACME? need to know whether this is a provisioning bug or account misconfig.

kevin_sales: renewal date 2026-04-14, ACME was marked green last week but they just escalated to me. i'll join any customer-facing call.

elena_support: they gave an example payload and a screenshot of portal error. also noted they tried our CLI token reissue and got `403: key not found`. i dropped the screenshot in the ticket.

john_cs_manager: proposed playbook: 1) 30m engineering triage to confirm root cause (eng-infra). 2) temporary workaround: manual key restore or short-lived token so enablement can finish. 3) 1h customer enablement session to complete onboarding + capture questions. 4) comms: apology + ETA + escalation owner. target: <6 hours. if we miss, escalate to exec sponsor.

maria_enablement: drafting the customer email now — short, clear, offers a 1h rescue session and a manual workaround. will post draft to #cs-templates and ping @elena_support for verification.

kevin_sales: please include a clear ask for acceptance criteria so I can lock the renewal conversation after the session.

elena_support: FYI opened ticket INC-2026-451 and added logs. tagging eng-oncall next. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: incident INC-2026-451 created and assigned to eng-oncall.

john_cs_manager: thanks team. Maria, let's run the enablement at 16:00 PT if eng confirms workaround by 15:30 PT. I'll follow up with a short comms template after the draft.

maria_enablement: ack — will update thread with draft and calendar invite.

elena_support: closing loop here, i'll attach the portal screenshot and customer quotes to the ticket and follow up on engineer thread.

kevin_sales: joining the enablement call, will prep renewal context.

john_cs_manager: moving to action — assigning owners: eng triage = eng-oncall, workaround = elena_support + eng, enablement session = maria_enablement, renewal comms = kevin_sales + john_cs_manager. we will reconvene in this thread after the session. :white_check_mark:
